references.label: 贵妃沙发

references.use: Scale reference for independent window chaise; no placement authority.

references.use: Native ash frame and pale ivory linen/cotton interpretation; no product photograph used as texture.

references.use: Silhouette reference only; user requested A is lower and smaller: 1100–1300×600–750×280–330, stone top plus wood structure.

references.label: 大几

references.label: 套几(大)

references.use: B auxiliary wood-table size/silhouette cue. Keep it visually distinct from principal stone oval; no duplicated main table.

references.label: 小套几
references.observed: Round top, open U-shaped wood-leg/bracing geometry; no drawer box.

references.use: Door/frame and shallow-depth language. Remove tall upper hutch in project low-sideboard adaptation, keep front doors facing SOUTH/kitchen.

references.label: 餐边柜(可做藤编门)
references.observed: Twin framed lower front doors, center drawers/cubby; light solid timber case on slender raised legs.
references.use: Storage division and leg language; no literal replication at catalogue height.

references.label: 六斗柜
references.observed: Low six-drawer timber case on short separate legs; strong horizontal top/case edge.
references.use: Low case-height proportion only. Requested sideboard has front doors and ash finish, not drawers or amber slab color.

references.label: 装饰柜
references.observed: Shallow open compartment cabinet with central drawer and tapered legs.
references.use: Fine leg and open/closed rhythm reference; catalogue height not authorized project height.

references.label: 云朵小茶几
references.observed: Cloud/soft organic timber top with one broad curved panel and a cylindrical support; very distinct smaller-table silhouette.
references.use: Alternative B auxiliary language in pale ash. Source height450 is not project height authority.

references.label: 长茶几
references.observed: Long timber top with two vertical panel supports and open underside.

references.label: 三位沙发
references.observed: Angled straight timber side members, two horizontal open arm rails, visible separated ivory pads.
references.use: Construction cue; amber stain does not transfer into house palette.

references.label: 沙发
references.observed: Soft upholstered seat/back; curved outer wood side panel with vertical narrow flutes; timber/plinth beneath.
references.use: Panel/slat rhythm only; 1030 depth is substantially deeper than ash1020 family and is not selected footprint.

references.label: 餐边柜
references.observed: Slim tapered timber legs; framed lower front doors; narrow perimeter frame; open appliance bay and upper sliding panels.
references.use: Front-door/frame construction only. Tall hutch, dark walnut appearance, and1800 height are excluded from this low sideboard.

authorized_adaptations.L_sofa: ash-frame ivory linen; use catalogue construction without claiming off-the-shelf L SKU
authorized_adaptations.coffee_B: principal oval/racetrack stone/wood table plus smaller clearly distinct wood auxiliary; open underside, no nightstand drawer box

palette.status: non-calibrated project interpretation; not manufacturer color code
palette.guidance: Keep dominant frames/sideboard warm pale sand ash with low saturation and subtle open grain; ivory linen and warm pale stone. Use amber only as an isolated small movable accent if needed; do not recolor walls, floor, fixed cabinets or the full house dark brown.

limitations: Catalogue dimensions are references, not purchase/fabrication confirmation.

Project L sofa, low sideboard and lower stone coffee are adaptations to user brief.
